learning_objective: 🎯 Understand the value of traditional crafts, perseverance, and following your passion through Sentila's journey of becoming a pot maker!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Sentila, a young girl, passionately wanted to be a pot maker. However, her mother, Arenla, strongly opposed it because pot making was physically exhausting, messy, and didn't bring much money. She wanted Sentila to learn weaving instead.

Sentila tried learning from her mother for a whole year but was unsuccessful. Making pots requires immense patience, physical strength, and perfect control over the clay, which she couldn't master initially.
Sentila did not give up. She watched other expert potters carefully. When she was struggling and exhausted, an expert potter named Onula encouraged her and gently guided her in shaping the pots.
Through deep interest, careful observation, and hard work, Sentila finally crafted beautiful, well-balanced pots. The story ends beautifully with the line, 'A new pot maker was born.'

Sentila's father, Mesoba, supported her because he understood that traditional skills and history belong to the whole community. It is a responsibility to pass them to the next generation so the craft doesn't die.

fun_activity.title: 🏺 Clay Play
fun_activity.instructions: Take some clay or play-dough (आटा). Try to make a perfectly round, balanced, and hollow mini-pot using just your hands (no machines). You'll realize how much skill, focus, and patience it takes!

exam_tips: 📌 Contrast Arenla's practical fears (hard work, less financial reward) with Sentila's passion for the art.
📌 Be ready to explain the role of 'perseverance' in Sentila's life. She failed for a year but never quit.
📌 Understand the meaning of the quote: 'The tradition and history of the people did not belong to any individual.' It highlights shared cultural heritage.
quick_recap: ⭐ The story is written by Temsula Ao and is set in the Naga hills.
⭐ Weaving was considered an easier and more profitable job for women compared to pottery.
⭐ Sentila's success proves that natural talent combined with true dedication always leads to success.
